So far only parameters in the run files have been added, as a proof of concept. The work on the parameters is indeed experimental and the goal is to find a way to collect parameters and use the information to validate parameters file.


```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

create_param_table <- function(file) {
  dt <- system.file(file, package = "atlantio", mustWork = TRUE) |>
    yaml12::read_yaml() |>
    lapply(\(x) data.frame(x)) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Version = paste0(Version_start, "-", Version_stop),
      Units = ifelse(is.na(Units), "none", Units)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Name, Category, Description, Type, Units, Version
    )
  rownames(dt) <- dt$Name
  dt <- dt |> dplyr::select(
    !c(Name)
  )
  dt |>
    kableExtra::kbl() |>
    kableExtra::kable_paper() |>
    kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "500px") |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", font_size = 12)
}

create_categ_table <- function(file) {
  dt <- system.file(file, package = "atlantio", mustWork = TRUE) |>
    yaml12::read_yaml() |>
    lapply(\(x) data.frame(x)) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()
  dt |>
    kableExtra::kbl() |>
    kableExtra::kable_paper() |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", font_size = 12)
}
```

# Run parameters 

## List of parameters

```{r run, echo = FALSE}
create_param_table("parameters/run.yaml")
```

## Categories 

```{r categ_run, echo = FALSE}
create_categ_table("parameters/run_categories.yaml")
```
